text:
Estadio Azteca wɔbuee no wɔ 29 May 1966, ne agorɔ a ɛdi kan no yɛ 2–2 draw a ɛne Club América ne Torino. Wɔde Mexican architects Pedro Ramírez Vázquez ne Rafael Mijares Alcérreca yɛɛ no, na ɛfiri mfitiaseɛ no ɛyɛ Club América fie a ɛtena hɔ daa ne Mexico ɔman team fie a ɛtena hɔ daa — ne din a ɛkɔ so daa no.

Beaeɛ no yɛ Grupo Televisa dea firi 1966. Wɔ 2024 restructuring mu no, wɔde operations no kɔɔ Grupo Ollamani a wɔakyerɛw wɔ public, a ɛnnɛ ɛhwɛ stadium no so na ɛdi Club América so, na ownership a ɛdi akyiri no kɔ so wɔ Televisa group mu. Din abakɔsɛm no sane kɔɔ so wɔ 14 March 2025, ɛberɛ a Grupo Financiero Banorte nyaa naming rights na wɔsan too beaeɛ no Estadio Banorte. Ma 2026 World Cup no, FIFA de neutral din "Mexico City Stadium" (Estadio Ciudad de México) di dwuma, ɛfiri sɛ corporate din nni hɔ wɔ tournament no mu.

Beaeɛ kɛseɛ biara nni sɛ ɛwɔ record a ɛte saa. Ɛyɛ stadium a ɛdi kan a ɛgye World Cup finals mmienu na ɛyɛ beaeɛ a ɛdi kan a ɛgye men’s World Cups mmiɛnsa, wɔ 1970, 1986 ne 2026 — na ɛdi kan a ɛgye World Cup opening matches mmiɛnsa. Ne nsa kɔ akyiri football: ɛgye 1968 Summer Olympics, 1975 Pan-American Games ne 1999 FIFA Confederations Cup. Wɔde too hɔ wɔ 2,200 m (7,220 ft) sorɔ no, ne sorɔ no yɛ ɔhaw a ɛma team a wɔaba no, adeɛ a ɛne ne lore no bom. Ɛnam din ne ownership nsakraeɛ nyinaa mu no, stadium no kɔ so yɛ one of the great cathedrals of the global game.
